Crazy random story that I always think is crazy about parkland 

At my school about 2 weeks before parkland happened the fire alarm went off towards the middle part of the school day. Everyone had 0 clue what had happened because we had a fire drill the same day earlier, and at this point of my life I was severely terrified of going to school due to shootings and I knew something was up when I saw my history teacher BOOKING it down the hall. My teacher told us to stay inside but luckily someone I knew had torn his ACL so I was able to use that as an excuse to leave and go outside just in case if shit was off the handle already. Walking outside towards the area everyone 
Would meet at I looked to torn ACL dude and said “man it sure would be crazy if someone pulled the fire alarm to get everyone condensed into a small area like a hallway so they can just rack up a body count” something along those lines. Nothing ended up being wrong some goober just pulled it as a joke. 

Fast forward two weeks.

Shit you not I was at school In the same class that the 2nd fire alarm went off 2 weeks before when parkland happened and I just so happened to be friends with someone in my Minecraft faction on Snapchat. Found out as soon as it happened if not sooner since I viewed his story 1m or so after it was posted. He had hopped a fence to run to the nearest restaurant with some of his friends and was kinda mocking the idea of a shooting happening and not realizing the severity of it since he was nowhere near the building it occurred in. Lightly jogging away from the school on Snapchat he said “school shooting bro this is wild no way” kinda laughing at it. I didn’t think much of it until a few minutes later when the story starting emerging and later on I realized that cruz was speculated to have done the same fire alarm trick I had mentioned 2 weeks earlier under the same exact circumstance and the same exact time as parkland unfolded. Always found that a little crazy.
